title: Repository Ownership and Governance Architecture Register

core_stop_rules: Single Workpack Boundary: Touch only allowed_write_paths specified in plan.json
Missing Input Returns BLOCKED: No invented authorities, receipts, or mock approvals
Never Self-Accept & Never Self-Merge: Author PRs must remain OPEN awaiting detached Ed25519 signatures
No History Overwrite or Deletion: Preserve root commits and all historical nodes; forward recovery only
Dual-Source Immutability: Read-only source snapshots in external custody; never clone legacy history into target
Custody & Secrets Isolation: Signing keys, credentials, and private learner logs stored strictly outside target repo
Strict UI Freeze: Zero learner UI, views, or renderers authored prior to signed A61 acceptance
Zero Unapproved Public Classification: All repository material default to internal or restricted classification

OWNER.title: Project Owner / Executive Governance
OWNER.authority_scope: Full executive authority; project charter, release approvals, authority delegation, policy overrides

ADMINISTRATOR.title: Repository Administrator / Custody Guardian
ADMINISTRATOR.authority_scope: Infrastructure security, trust roster maintenance, secret custody, CI guard runner, branch protection, history-preserving merge enforcement

INDEPENDENT_REVIEWER.title: Independent Reviewer / External Verifier
INDEPENDENT_REVIEWER.authority_scope: Cryptographic detached verification, candidate PR audit, receipt issuance with Ed25519 signing, test oracle execution

ACADEMIC_AUTHORITY.title: Academic Domain Authority
ACADEMIC_AUTHORITY.authority_scope: Canonical subject truth, 6-core role contracts, cognitive demand boundaries (Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry; Biology pending)

ARCHITECT.title: System & Domain Architect
ARCHITECT.authority_scope: Contract specifications, JSON schemas, 6-core blueprint mapping, architectural registers, dependency topology

MIGRATION_ENGINEER.title: Lossless Migration Engineer
MIGRATION_ENGINEER.authority_scope: Byte inventory, bitwise restore, safe relative path traversal guards, legacy mapping, count conservation

PLATFORM_ENGINEER.title: Platform & Tooling Engineer
PLATFORM_ENGINEER.authority_scope: Build harnesses, test suites, CLI runners, namespace packaging, synthetic test fixtures

UI_ENGINEER.title: UI & Presentation Engineer (FROZEN)
UI_ENGINEER.authority_scope: Presentation templates, tablet viewports, DOM renderers. STRICTLY INACTIVE / FROZEN until A61 signed acceptance

RESTRICTED_CUSTODY.description: Private signing keys, authentication credentials, raw source snapshots, private learner telemetry, proprietary benchmark items
RESTRICTED_CUSTODY.storage_location: External custody directory strictly outside target repository
RESTRICTED_CUSTODY.access_policy: Administrator and authorized reviewer only; never checked into target repository

INTERNAL_GOVERNANCE.description: Authority baselines, trust rosters, audit evidence, handoff packets, signed receipts, baseline audits, containment reports
INTERNAL_GOVERNANCE.storage_location: Target repository docs/ or external trust directory
INTERNAL_GOVERNANCE.access_policy: Project stakeholders and independent reviewers; internal use only

INTERNAL_ENGINEERING.description: Target source code, unit and integration tests, JSON schemas, architectural specifications, build tools
INTERNAL_ENGINEERING.access_policy: Engineering team and automated CI verification runners

CANDIDATE_REVIEW.description: Candidate pull request trees, draft workpack deliverables, staged integration branches awaiting review
CANDIDATE_REVIEW.storage_location: Open candidate branches and PRs on GitHub
CANDIDATE_REVIEW.access_policy: Author and independent reviewer; merge strictly gated on detached cryptographic receipt

PUBLIC_PROJECTION.description: Public documentation, sanitized client assets, or released educational packages
PUBLIC_PROJECTION.storage_location: Public branch or distribution directory (CURRENTLY NONE)
PUBLIC_PROJECTION.access_policy: Requires separate, explicit, independently signed Owner authorization (release_enabled: True)

MIGRATED.description: Legacy content actively transformed and incorporated into target architecture with verified lineage

PRESERVED_IN_CUSTODY.description: Raw source bytes preserved immutably in authorized external custody outside target repo

LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY.description: Legacy compatibility shims, routes, or historical adapters required for migration continuity

REGENERATED_WITH_LINEAGE.description: Cleanly regenerated from verified source with deterministic hash and transformation lineage

QUARANTINED.description: Ambiguous, unreviewed, conflicting, or unadmitted items isolated pending explicit Owner decision

HISTORICAL_PRESERVED.description: Historical records, prior commit trees, and review records preserved for provenance without modification

BLOCKED_MISSING_BYTES.description: Declared or referenced items with missing raw payloads or broken source pointers
BLOCKED_MISSING_BYTES.target_scope: Identified in migration ledger as blocking gaps

STRICTLY FROZEN until independent signed acceptance of Workpack A61

Orchestration checkers and scope validation guards

dependency_boundary_rules.rationale: Client web runtimes must never import custody, unreviewed candidates, or internal QA tools
Web presentation adapters cannot access raw student progress internals or governance policy
Data payloads must remain pure declarative JSON without executable code or script injection
Distribution packages must be strictly reproducibly generated from source
Migration importers have no authority to grant approvals or trigger releases
Search indexes may only index released public projections, never internal custody
Sandboxed legacy apps must not access parent DOM, protected student attempts, or network
Portable packages cannot embed executable scripts or fixed pixel presentation hacks
Core 2 transfer practice must bind to reviewed crux and demand, never invent mastery
Core 1 canonical inference must not depend on source question text or estimated learner level
